Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.

3. By way of the present petition, the petitioners are seeking quashing of the FIR bearing no.
05/2023, registered at Police Station Dabri, New Delhi, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter 'IPC').
4. Issue notice.
The learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State.
5. The petitioners sand respondent no.2 are present before this Court and have been identified by their counsel and Investigating Officer (IO)

6. Brief facts of the case are that the marriage between the petitioner no. 1 and respondent no. 2 was solemnized on 08.02.2021 according to Hindu Rites and Customs.

sentences.text: It is stated that due to various differences, disputes and issues had arisen between the petitioner no. 1 and respondent no. 2.
Upon the complaint made by respondent no. 2, the present FIR came to be registered against the petitioner.

It is stated that with intervention of the family and friends, the parties have now amicably settled their dispute before the Mediation Centre, Dwarka Courts, New Delhi vide Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) dated 06.06.2024.
7.

entities.text: Mediation Centre, Dwarka Courts, New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: On a query made by this Court, respondent no. 2 who has been identified by the IO, has categorically stated that she has entered into compromise out of her own free will and without any pressure, coercion or threat and has received the entire payment as per settlement arrived at between them.
Therefore, she has no objection if the present FIR is quashed.
8. In view of the above, that the parties have amicably resolved their differences of their own free will, and without any coercion, no useful purpose will be served by continuing the proceedings

,
rather the same would create further acrimony between them.
It would thus be in interest of justice to quash the abovementioned FIR and the proceedings pursuant thereto.
There is no legal impediment in quashing the FIR in question.

9. Accordingly, FIR bearing no. 05/2023, registered at Police Station Dabri, New Delhi, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A/406/34 of IPC and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
